metadata.name: bots
metadata.description: The bestiary: a map of bot handle -> { name, persona, model } layered on the shared plastron primer. Edit/extend it like any cel; =addbot mints additional bots as grok.roster.<handle> cels (merged in). The xAI key lives server-side in the grok edge function, never here.

smith.name: Formula Smith
smith.persona: Terse and precise. You forge the single cleanest formula for the job.

muse.name: The Muse
muse.persona: Playful and lateral. You find an unexpected but valid formula angle.

analyst.name: The Analyst
analyst.persona: You prefer aggregates (SUM/AVERAGE/COUNTIF) and reason about the data in the sheet.

metadata.name: bot
metadata.description: The currently-selected bot handle (a key of the bestiary — grok.bots or a grok.roster.* mint). Default 'smith'. The formula-bar 🔮 trigger and the chat card ask this bot unless overridden (chat: '@handle …' routes one message).

metadata.name: project
metadata.description: Which Supabase project (sb.<project>.url / .anonkey) hosts the grok edge function. Default 'default'.

metadata.name: transcript
metadata.description: The chat thread: a LIST OF MESSAGE DICTS [{role:'user'|'assistant'|'receipt', bot?, text, ts?, tool?}] (the collections hub form). grok.send appends turns; grok.applytools appends receipts ('wrote sheet9.B2 := =SUM(…)'); the chat card renders it reactively. Being a cel, it archives with the document and is formula-inspectable.

metadata.name: scratch
metadata.description: The evaluate_formula tool's dry-run cel: the tool commits the candidate formula here (through the same sniff a keyboard commit gets) and returns the computed value — no sheet is touched.

metadata.name: snap
metadata.description: 'Snapshot before applying' toggle (write-back doctrine, default ON): when truthy and the checkpoint segment is loaded, grok.applytools takes a checkpoint ('grok-pre-apply') before a batch containing write_cell — checkpoint.restore is the undo story. Set false to skip.

metadata.name: grok.context
metadata.description: (state, seg) -> string. ONE segment's SOURCE cells as plain lines (formula TEXT or value JSON), excluding sync control cels. Capped. The 🔮 formula-bar ask sends this; the chat card sends the whole workbook (grok.workbook-context).

metadata.name: grok.workbook-context
metadata.description: (state, wbRef?) -> string. The ACTIVE workbook (win.active, else the first win.*.state with a sheets tab list) as capped plain text: every sheet's dims + source cells (formula TEXT, value JSON) and every dom-view's formula — read from the wbframe state shape {sheets:[{ref,title}], views:[…]}. This is what chat bots see.

metadata.name: grok.ask
metadata.description: (state, seg, question, botHandle?) -> {ok, reply, bot} | {ok:false, error}. Assemble [system(primer+persona), context+question], invoke the server-side grok proxy (supabase.invoke) WITH the tool surface (read_cells / write_cell / evaluate_formula / vocabulary); tool calls in the reply are applied through the user's commit path (receipted in grok.transcript, loop capped at 4 rounds) and the final reply — a plastron FORMULA for the bar — returns. xAI key stays server-side.

metadata.name: grok.applytools
metadata.description: (state, toolCalls) -> [{role:'tool', tool_call_id, content}]. Apply a model reply's tool_calls THROUGH THE USER'S COMMIT PATH (typed-entry sniff -> setCel; read_cells/vocabulary read-only; evaluate_formula dry-runs in grok.scratch) and return the follow-up tool messages for the next round. Every application appends a receipt dict to grok.transcript; a write batch checkpoints first when grok.snap is on. No privileged mutation surface.

metadata.name: url
metadata.description: The FULL chat-completion endpoint URL grok.fetch / the chat card POST to (e.g. a Supabase edge function /functions/v1/grok). Seed it from a gitignored .env — never commit a real project URL. Empty = the card falls back to supabase.invoke.

metadata.name: email
metadata.description: Login form buffer: the email typed into the login card (grok.field writes it). Seed from .env for tests.

metadata.name: password
metadata.description: Login form buffer: the password typed into the login card. Never persisted to a segment archive; .env-seeded for tests.

metadata.name: question
metadata.description: Chat composer buffer: the message typed into the card's textarea (grok.field writes it). grok.send consumes and clears it.

metadata.name: reply
metadata.description: LEGACY MIRROR of grok.transcript: the shipped card formula (=grok.ui(…, grok.reply)) predates the transcript cel, so every transcript append is mirrored here to keep that formula reactive. New formulas should reference grok.transcript; drop the mirror once the card formula does.

metadata.name: status
metadata.description: Login status line ('✓ signed in as …' / '✗ error' / 'signed-out', written by grok.signin / grok.signout). The card view formula references it; without an explicit authed arg, the '✓' prefix is what flips the card from login to chat.

metadata.name: grok.fetch
metadata.description: (state, question, botHandle?) -> {ok, reply, bot} | {ok:false, error}. DIRECT chat-completion fetch to the grok.url cel (from a gitignored .env), authorised with the signed-in user's Supabase JWT (resolved at the effect site, never a cel). Accepts {reply} or raw xAI {choices:[{message:{content}}]}.

metadata.name: grok.field
metadata.description: (state, cellKey, event) -> void. An input's keystroke -> a cel (login/chat card buffers grok.email/password/question). Dispatch target for on('input', 'grok.field', '<cel>').

metadata.name: grok.signin
metadata.description: (state, project?) -> string. The login card's Sign-in button: supabase.auth signin with grok.email/grok.password, write grok.status, repaint. State-aware (the state-arg wall) — dispatched, never called from a formula.

metadata.name: grok.signout
metadata.description: (state, project?) -> string. The chat header's Sign-out: supabase.auth signout (revoke + forget the session), grok.status := 'signed-out' (the card flips back to login), repaint. Dispatched, never called from a formula.

metadata.name: grok.send
metadata.description: (state, project?) -> string. The composer's Send: append the user turn to grok.transcript, send [chat primer + persona + grok.workbook-context, history] with the tool surface, run the tool loop (writes receipted), append the assistant turn. '@handle …' routes one message to that bot. Dispatched from the card, never from a formula.

metadata.name: grok.key
metadata.description: (state, project, event) -> void. The composer textarea's keydown: Enter sends (grok.send), Shift+Enter newlines. Dispatch target for on('keydown', 'grok.key', '<project>').

metadata.name: grok.pickbot
metadata.description: (state, handle) -> void. The chat header's bot chips: select the active bot (grok.bot := handle, if it exists in the bestiary) and repaint. Dispatched, never called from a formula.

metadata.name: grok.addbot
metadata.description: (state, name, persona?, model?) -> handle. DISPATCHED bot mint: MERGE {name, persona, model} into the grok.bots dict under slug(name) (the cel chat formulas reference, so the new chip appears reactively), repaint. The formula twin is =addbot (genesis — a formula-owned grok.roster.* cel, swept with its formula).

metadata.name: addbot
metadata.description: (name, persona?, model?) GENESIS: mint a chat bot as a grok.roster.<handle> cel — a {name, persona, model} dict merged into the bestiary (grok.bots + roster). Formula-owned document recipe: it dehydrates with the sheet that authored it, and deleting the formula sweeps the bot away. '@handle …' in the chat routes a message to it.

metadata.name: chatpane
metadata.description:
(transcript, draft, opts?) -> vnode. THE pure chat renderer (sheetbar pattern: instance cels as args) — author the whole chat from a GRID CELL by wrapping it in =view; referencing the cels IS the reactivity. Appkit-styled: opts.authed=false (pass signedIn(sb.

.auth)) gates to the login card (near-black header band, Email/Password, Sign in); signed in renders the thread — bot chips, slate-50 stream, Telegram bubbles (user solid #334155, bot/peer white-bordered — human:true dicts show 👤 name — receipts amber chips), rounded-full composer, Enter sends. opts: {project, authed, bots, bot, status, email, password} + instance wiring {title, draftCel, send, key, placeholder, chips:false} so a sibling surface (the room chat) reuses the renderer with its own verbs/cels. Inputs dispatch grok.field; buttons grok.signin//grok.pickbot/grok.signout.
metadata.example: =view("chat", chatpane(grok.transcript, grok.question, {project:"default", authed:signedIn(sb.default.auth), bots:grok.bots, bot:grok.bot, email:grok.email, password:grok.password, status:grok.status}))

metadata.name: loginpane
metadata.description:
(opts) -> vnode. The login card as ITS OWN =view surface: signed out, the appkit login card (near-black band, Email/Password, Sign in -> grok.signin); signed in, the SESSION card — avatar initial, 'Signed in as ' (opts.session = sb.

.auth), Sign out. opts: {project, authed:signedIn(sb.

.auth), email, password, status, session}.
metadata.example: =view("login", loginpane({project:"default", authed:signedIn(sb.default.auth), email:grok.email, password:grok.password, status:grok.status, session:sb.default.auth}))

metadata.name: roomspane
metadata.description: (rooms, opts) -> vnode. The CHATROOMS view over appkit's conversations: one clickable row per room (🏛 lounge / 👥 group / 👤 dm, title, last-message snippet, unread badge) dispatching grok.pickroom; a ↻ Refresh button dispatching grok.loadrooms; the selected row (opts.room) highlighted; signed out -> the sign-in hint. opts: {project, authed, room, status}.

metadata.name: rooms
metadata.description: The appkit chatrooms visible to the signed-in user: [{id, kind:'lounge'|'group'|'dm', title, last_body, last_at, unread}] — written by grok.loadrooms (the list_conversations RPC, RLS-scoped). roomspane renders it; referencing it in the pane formula IS the reactivity.

metadata.name: room
metadata.description: The SELECTED conversation id (a grok.rooms[].id uuid) — grok.pickroom writes it and loads that room's messages; grok.roomsend posts into it. Empty = no room selected.

metadata.name: roomtitle
metadata.description: The selected room's display title (grok.pickroom writes it) — pass as chatpane's opts.title so the room-chat header names the room reactively.

metadata.name: roomlog
metadata.description: The selected room's messages mapped into chatpane's dict shape: my rows {role:'user', text, ts}, everyone else {role:'assistant', human:true, bot:<profile name>, text, ts}. Written by grok.loadmsgs (RLS member-gated select on appkit's chat table); poll-on-send/switch. Distinct from grok.transcript (the standalone grok chat).

metadata.name: roomq
metadata.description: Room-chat composer buffer (grok.field writes it via chatpane's opts.draftCel). grok.roomsend consumes and clears it.

metadata.name: peers
metadata.description: profile id -> display name map (appkit's profile table), loaded with the rooms — labels other people's bubbles (👤 name) and derives DM titles.

metadata.name: grok.loadrooms
metadata.description: (state, project?) -> rooms. Fetch the signed-in user's chatrooms from appkit's DB (the list_conversations RPC via supabase.data, user JWT -> RLS applies) into grok.rooms, refresh grok.peers, repaint. The roomspane ↻ Refresh button dispatches it; grok.signin auto-runs it when a rooms view is open. Errors land on grok.status.

metadata.name: grok.loadmsgs
metadata.description: (state, project?) -> log. Load the selected room's messages (member-gated select on appkit's chat table, oldest-first, cap 200) into grok.roomlog, mapped to chatpane dicts (mine -> role:'user'; others -> role:'assistant' + human:true + their profile name; task/report bodies show as a tagged snippet). Poll-on-send/switch — live arrival via supabase.realtime's rev bump is future wiring.

metadata.name: grok.pickroom
metadata.description: (state, roomId) -> void. 'Select one and go into chat': grok.room := id, grok.roomtitle := its title, load the room's messages, then FOCUS the roomchat view tab (window.viewTab on the workbook hosting roomchat.view, then window.raise) and repaint. Dispatched by a roomspane row click.

metadata.name: grok.roomsend
metadata.description: (state, project?) -> string. Send grok.roomq into the selected appkit room: an RLS-gated INSERT into the chat table AS YOURSELF (author_id = your auth uid), '@*handle' summons appkit's bot-responder with the new chat_id (fire-and-forget — appkit's own mention contract), reload the log, repaint. Sibling of grok.send (the standalone grok chat), never an overload.

metadata.name: grok.roomkey
metadata.description: (state, project, event) -> void. The room composer's keydown: Enter sends (grok.roomsend), Shift+Enter newlines. Pass as chatpane's opts.key in the room-chat formula.

metadata.name: grok.ui
metadata.description:
(project, email, password, status, question, thread, authed?, bots?, bot?) -> vnode. Positional compat wrapper over chatpane — the =chatcard cardBook formula's entry. `thread` is the grok.transcript list (grok.reply mirrors it; a plain string renders as one bot bubble); `authed` is signedIn(sb.

.auth), defaulting to the '✓' status prefix. New docs should author chatpane from a grid cell instead.
metadata.example: =grok.ui('default', grok.email, grok.password, grok.status, grok.question, grok.transcript, signedIn(sb.default.auth), grok.bots, grok.bot)
